root_cause: Missing NULL check on unit->content_ref before dereferencing it as a parsed slice header structure; the code assumed that any CBS unit with a slice-like NAL unit type would always have its content_ref populated, which is not guaranteed for malformed/incompletely parsed bitstreams.
findings: In set_pict_type(), when determining the picture type for a VVC frame, the code iterates over the CodedBitstreamUnit array of the current access unit and, for every unit whose type is <= VVC_RSV_IRAP_11 (i.e. a slice NAL unit), directly dereferences unit->content_ref as an H266RawSliceHeader* without first checking that content_ref is non-NULL.
